summary: Describes an EPP extension for provisioning and managing DNSSEC information for domain names stored in a shared registry. It extends the EPP domain name mapping, specified in XML, to carry the data needed for DNS security. It is a standards-track document that was later replaced by RFC 5910.

eli5.summary: Registrars use a messaging system to update domain records. This extension lets them also hand over the security keys that protect the domain.

questions: how to provision dnssec in a registry
